mainEntity.name: How do you manage unforeseen issues during a restoration project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unforeseen issues are common in home restoration, especially in older properties where underlying conditions may be hidden. We manage these by conducting thorough initial inspections to minimize surprises and maintaining open communication with the homeowner. When issues arise, we pause work, assess the problem, provide a clear explanation of options, and get client approval before proceeding. This process clarity ensures that any necessary adjustments to the project scope or budget are transparently communicated and agreed upon.
